description: This PHP class 'FormatWithLanguage' implements a value formatter strategy that retrieves a language's name based on an entity value which is presumably a language ID. It interacts with the LanguageService to fetch the Language entity and obtain its name.

classes.name: FormatWithLanguage
classes.description: A class that formats a value by translating a language ID into the language's name using the LanguageService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the language name for a given entity value (language ID), or null if not found.

methods.name: getLanguageService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LanguageService to access language data.
